_about: Part cards: complex parts learned before the first kanji that uses them. glyph -> keyword (the part name used in stories), components (its named pieces), story, picture (scene for tools/gen_images.py --parts). tools/build_parts.py copies them into kanji.json "partCards" with the kanji that use each one.

寺.story: Monks heap [soil] into a mound and [glue] every brick on top of it, raising a {Buddhist temple} with a giant sundial in its courtyard.
寺.picture: Monks in robes heaping soil and gluing bricks into a small temple with a large sundial in the courtyard.

⺼.story: Under a butcher's [hood] of wax paper, two chips of [ice] keep a dripping red slab of {flesh} cold, ready to dangle in front of a bull.
⺼.picture: A slab of raw red meat lying under a waxed paper hood with two chips of ice on it, a curious bull peering in.

聿.story: A fist grips a tall stick, and stacked strokes of bristles fan out across it: a giant calligraphy {brush}, dripping ink and ready to write.
聿.picture: A hand gripping a tall calligraphy brush with thick bristles, dripping black ink onto a shop counter.

舌.story: A [thousand] taste buds bristle as a [mouth] below gapes open and a long, wet {tongue} flops out, wriggling and drooling.
舌.picture: A wide-open cartoon mouth with a huge floppy tongue covered in countless tiny taste buds, drool dripping.

玉.story: A [king] lets a single sparkling [drop] fall beside his royal chest: it hardens into his crown {jewel}, which a squawking bird guards day and night.
玉.picture: A cartoon king watching a sparkling drop turn into a big gemstone by his side, guarded by a white cockatoo.

門.story: Two swinging saloon doors, each with its little window, flap back and forth on their hinges: the {gate}, slamming shut every few seconds.
門.picture: Two swinging wooden saloon doors with small windows, flapping open with sunlight streaming through the gap.

艮.story: A gnarled stump with a hooked top and tendrils kicking out at the bottom: a dried {root} yanked from the earth, still clinging to clumps of dirt.
艮.picture: A dried, gnarled root just pulled from the ground, with clumps of dirt clinging to its tendrils.

廿.story: Two tens welded together at the bottom like a little crib with a crossbar: just room for {twenty} babies lined up side by side.
廿.picture: A long wooden crib with two upright posts and a crossbar, twenty babies lined up neatly inside.

貝.story: A giant [eye] peeks out of a clam that scuttles on [eight] tiny legs: {shells}, the old money, watching to make sure you spend them wisely.
貝.picture: A big clam shell with one giant eye peeking out, walking on eight tiny legs across a pile of coins.

豕.story: A flat back on top, a belly sagging down, stubby legs and a curly tail kicking out to the right: a fat, muddy {sow} plopped on the ground.
豕.picture: A fat muddy pig with a curly tail lying contentedly on the ground.

里.story: A [rice field] grid for a screen, perched on a mound of [soil]: the farmer's homemade {computer}, its wires buried in the dirt.
里.picture: A crude computer whose screen is a tiny green rice paddy grid, sitting on a mound of dirt with wires running into the soil.

辶.story: A dot of a traveler sets off down a zigzag path that sweeps into one long flat stretch: the open {road}, stretching off toward the horizon.
辶.picture: A small traveler walking along a zigzagging dirt road that straightens into a long flat stretch toward the horizon.

頁.story: A tall boxy face with two eye lines, perched on two little legs: a giraffe's giant {head} swooping down from the treetops to stare at you.
頁.picture: A giraffe's huge head bending down from the treetops to stare curiously at a small zookeeper.

豆.story: A lidded bowl on a tall pedestal stand, its lid lifted off to show a steaming heap of {beans} ready for someone's face.
豆.picture: A tall pedestal bowl with its lid raised, full of steaming beans.

是.story: The [sun] sits on a [one]-plank shelf bolted to a [stop] sign; a fussy dinosaur nudges the sign left, then right, until it all stands {just so}: perfectly straight, perfectly centered.
是.picture: A fussy green dinosaur carefully straightening a red octagonal stop sign whose post holds a small wooden shelf with a glowing miniature sun on it, checking it with a spirit level.

昜.story: At [nightbreak] the sun peeks over the horizon, and a [pennant] flutters below it, stuck into a fat {piggy bank} to mark where the savings are buried.
昜.picture: A fat piggy bank half buried in the ground with a small pennant flag stuck in it, the sun rising behind.

云.story: [two] streaks of smoke hover over a bent [elbow] as a man puffs his pipe, sending a {rising cloud} up to the ceiling.
云.picture: A man with a bent elbow puffing a pipe, two streaks of smoke forming a big billowing cloud rising above him.

礻.story: A little stand with a dot of incense smoking on top and a post leaning to one side: a roadside {altar} where people stop to bow.
礻.picture: A small wooden roadside altar with a stick of incense smoking on top and a bowl of offerings.

斤.story: A long handle on the right with a heavy blade hanging off to the left: an {axe} dragged along the ground, its edge scraping sparks.
斤.picture: A heavy axe being dragged along a stone road, its blade scraping up sparks.

乍.story: A slanted handle on top and a row of jagged teeth jutting to the right: a carpenter's {saw}, mid-stroke and screeching.
乍.picture: A carpenter's hand saw mid-stroke through a plank, sawdust flying.

矢.story: A [banner top] flutters on the tail of a {dart} that a [St. Bernard dog] fetches in its jaws, wagging proudly, tail thumping the floor.
矢.picture: A St. Bernard dog proudly carrying a dart with a little flag fluttering on its tail in its mouth.

虫.story: A fat body speared on an upright stalk, one tiny leg kicking out at the bottom right: a beetle-like {insect} perched on a twig, antennae twitching.
虫.picture: A plump beetle perched upright on a twig, antennae twitching.

耂.story: A crooked cane slanting out from a little mound of earth: an {old man} sits hunched on the hill, lost in thought.
耂.picture: An old man with a long beard sitting hunched on a small grassy mound, leaning on a crooked cane, deep in thought.

孝.story: An [old man] rides piggyback on his [child], who carries him uphill without a word of complaint: {filial piety} at its most backbreaking.
孝.picture: A young child carrying a smiling old man piggyback up a steep hill path.

攵.story: A bent figure with a whip raised over one shoulder, legs striding wide apart: a stern {taskmaster} cracking the whip at his trembling pupils.
攵.picture: A stern man in an old-fashioned outfit raising a whip over his shoulder while nervous students bow before him.

甬.story: With a bent [elbow], a clerk raises the stamp he loves to [utilize] on everything: the giant red {chop-seal} thunks down again and again.
甬.picture: A clerk with a bent elbow slamming a huge red stamp onto a stack of papers, red ink splattering.

癶.story: Two pairs of poles splay outward, crossing at the top with flaps hanging down either side: a {teepee}, its door flaps open and smoke curling out.
癶.picture: A canvas teepee with crossed poles sticking out the top and its door flaps open, smoke curling from the top.

羊.story: A [horned lid] of curly horns sits on [two] thick rolls of wool, and a shepherd's [walking stick] pokes straight down through them: a fluffy {sheep}.
羊.picture: A fluffy sheep with curly horns and thick rolls of wool, a shepherd's staff standing beside it.

軍.story: A [crown]-shaped canopy stretched over a [car]: the general's armored jeep rolls ahead of the whole marching {army}.
軍.picture: An armored jeep with a canvas canopy on top leading long columns of marching toy soldiers down a road.

隹.story: A plump bird with a little head, a fat upright body and rows of feathers stacked like shelves: a {turkey}, puffed up and ready to gobble.
隹.picture: A plump turkey with rows of fanned feathers stacked neatly, puffed up proudly on a branch.

占.story: A [magic wand] taps a [mouth] below, and it starts murmuring prophecies: {fortune-telling} sold one by one across a tiny booth's counter.
占.picture: A magic wand tapping a large mouth on a small shop counter, which whispers glowing prophecies.

歹.story: [one] bone laid across the top of a heap, and by [evening] the wolves have picked the rest clean: a pile of bleached {bones}.
歹.picture: A pile of bleached bones at evening under a dusky sky, one long bone lying across the top.

禾.story: A [slash] of a drooping ear bends over the top of a [tree]-like stalk: ripe {wheat}, so heavy with grain it bows its head.
禾.picture: A tall stalk of wheat shaped like a little tree, its heavy ear of grain drooping over the top.

竹.story: Two stalks standing side by side, each sprouting a pair of little leaves at the top: twin {bamboo} canes swaying in the breeze.
竹.picture: Two green bamboo stalks side by side, each with small leaves at the top, swaying in a breeze.

吏.story: With [one] stripe on his cap, a clerk memorizes the empire's whole [history] to become an {officer}, ready to obey any order.
吏.picture: A uniformed official with one stripe on his cap reading a thick old history book, standing at attention.

勿.story: A pole [bound up] in cloth, with one [slash] and another [slash] streaming from it in the wind: a {pennant}, planted to claim what's yours.
勿.picture: A cow planting a pole with a long forked pennant streaming in the wind next to a pile of its belongings.

斗.story: Two star dots spill into a long ladle whose handle is crossed by a bar: the {Big Dipper} scooping rice out of the night sky.
斗.picture: A ladle made of stars in the night sky scooping up a pile of white rice.

㫃.story: A signpost pointing the [direction] on the left, a [person] on the right hoisting a fluttering {banner} so the whole tribe knows where to march.
㫃.picture: A signpost pointing one way and a person beside it raising a big fluttering banner on a tall pole.

帚.story: A handle on top, a cloth wrapped round its middle and a shaggy fringe of bristles hanging below: a {broom}, leaning by the door for spring cleaning.
帚.picture: A tall straw broom with a cloth tied around its middle, leaning against a dusty doorway.

穴.story: Under a [house] roof, [eight] claw marks rake straight down: some beast has torn a {hole} right through the ceiling, letting in the sky.
穴.picture: A roof with a ragged hole clawed through it, deep claw marks around the edge and blue sky showing through.

糸.story: A silkworm [cocoon] unravels into [little] dangling strands below: fine silk {thread}, ready to be knotted or snapped.
糸.picture: A silkworm cocoon hanging from a twig, unraveling into thin silk threads dangling below.

疒.story: A slanted roof over a sickbed, with two drops of fever sweat dripping down the left side: {sickness}, the gloomy hospital ward where everyone moans.
疒.picture: A gloomy hospital ward under a slanted roof, with a feverish patient in bed and sweat drops falling.

央.story: A big man spreads his arms and legs, his chest locked inside a square frame: he is pinned dead {center}, like the bullseye of a target.
央.picture: A person standing spread-eagle at the exact center of a square target painted on a green lawn.

㑒.story: Under a [meeting roof], a cobbler with a [mouth] full of nails hunches over a [person]'s boot, jabbing holes with his sharp {awl}.
㑒.picture: A cobbler under a peaked roof with nails between his lips, punching holes in a leather boot with a pointed awl.

关.story: Two [horns] poke up through the [heavens], as if a huge bull were rising behind the clouds: the {horned heavens}, glowering over the road below.
关.picture: Two giant bull horns poking up through a cloudy sky above a long road.

灬.story: Four little flames flicker in a row along the bottom: the {oven fire}, licking up beneath a roasting tray.
灬.picture: Four small flames in a row flickering under a roasting tray inside an oven.

周.story: A [hood]-shaped fence encloses a patch of [soil] with a [mouth]-shaped pond in the middle; you jog the {circumference} of that fence every morning.
周.picture: A runner jogging around a fenced patch of dirt with a small square pond in the middle.

哥.story: My {big brother} stacks a [can] on top of another [can] to stand taller than me, then shouts through them like a megaphone.
哥.picture: An older boy standing on two stacked tin cans, shouting through a cone, towering over his little sibling.

羽.story: Two wings side by side, each a hooked frame holding two chips of [ice] like a pair of frozen [ice] feathers: a chick flaps them and its {feathers} crackle.
羽.picture: A small chick spreading two stiff wings, each wing a hooked frame with two shiny ice crystals inside, its frozen feathers crackling.

至.story: [one] last shove of an [elbow] and the dancer lands on the [soil] floor: the party hits its {climax}, everyone screaming.
至.picture: A crowded party where a dancer lands on a dirt floor after a big move, everyone cheering wildly.

罒.story: A flat box crisscrossed with cords, its square holes dripping water: a fishing {net}, held up to scoop whatever swims or shines below.
罒.picture: A rectangular fishing net with square mesh held up dripping water above a beach full of seashells.

尺.story: A bent hood on top with a long body sweeping down and kicking out to the right: a {shakuhachi flute} held at an angle, blasting sound from its end.
尺.picture: A long bamboo flute held at an angle, with sound waves bursting from its end over a sleeping town.

旦.story: The [sun] peeks up over [one] flat horizon line: {nightbreak}, the dark finally cracking open.
旦.picture: The sun just rising above a flat horizon line, the night sky breaking into light.

飠.story: A little roof over a bowl heaped with rice and a spoon tucked at its side: time to {eat}, and fast, before someone steals your share.
飠.picture: A small covered rice bowl heaped with rice, with a spoon beside it on a table.

亦.story: A stem on top, then a round fruit split open with juice dripping down both sides: a ripe {apple} cracked in half.
亦.picture: A ripe red apple split in half, juice dripping down both sides onto the soil.

亜.story: A squat pagoda with a flat roof above, a flat floor below and two posts between, stamped across the map: the symbol for {Asia}.
亜.picture: A map of a continent with a squat pagoda symbol stamped across it.

氏.story: A crooked family-tree branch ends in a hook with a nameplate swinging from it: your {family name}, dangling there for every relative to read.
氏.picture: A crooked tree branch with a hook at the end and a blank wooden nameplate swinging from it.

免.story: A hooded figure hunches over long legs and drags a tail behind him: a lazy kid mumbling an {excuse} to dodge his chores.
免.picture: A slouching hooded kid shrugging and making excuses while a pile of chores waits behind him.

戊.story: A tall ceremonial halberd with a long ribbon swooping down its left side, carried high at the front of the {parade}.
戊.picture: A tall ceremonial halberd with a ribbon streaming down its side, held high at the head of a festive parade with floats.

義.story: A [sheep (tailless)] stands proudly on top of my [ego], bleating about {righteousness} while I hold it up and nod along.
義.picture: A sheep without a tail standing on top of a puffed-up man's head, bleating sternly with a raised hoof.

旨.story: A [spoon] dips into a bowl glowing like the [sun] below: one taste and it is so {delicious} you lick the spoon clean.
旨.picture: A spoon dipping into a golden glowing bowl of food, a person happily licking their fingers.

戈.story: An [arrow] planted in the ground with a party ribbon [slash]ing across it: a spear decked out for the {fiesta}.
戈.picture: A smiling dancer at a colorful street parade waves a tall pole topped with a little flag and long ribbons.

衣.story: A collar on top, two sleeves spreading out and a hem flaring at the bottom: a {garment} hanging on a hook, waiting for someone to wear it.
衣.picture: A loose robe hanging on a hook, with a wide collar, spread sleeves and a flaring hem.

产.story: Under a [top hat] lid, [horns] stick out like handles; perched on the edge of a [cliff], it's a wobbly {vase on a cliff} about to tip.
产.picture: A vase with horn-shaped handles and a small hat for a lid, teetering on the edge of a cliff.

斉.story: A tuning fork balanced on two even stilts, its crossbar perfectly level: everything {adjusted} so each note rings true.
斉.picture: A tuning fork balanced on two straight stilts with a level crossbar, beside a row of water glasses.

其.story: Two handles stick up over a woven box with crossbars, standing on two little legs: a {bushel basket}, ready to catch anything that falls.
其.picture: A woven bushel basket with two upright handles, standing on two little legs under a night sky.

咅.story: A [vase] is strapped over the guard dog's [mouth] below: a clumsy {muzzle} that stops it barking at the city gate.
咅.picture: A guard dog wearing a vase strapped over its snout like a muzzle, standing by a city wall.

各.story: [walking legs] stride from door to door, stopping at every [mouth]-shaped mailbox to hand {each} member a name card.
各.picture: A pair of striding legs going door to door, dropping a card into each square mailbox.

炎.story: [fire] piled on top of [fire]: the wound burns so hot it blazes twice over, a throbbing {inflammation} that sizzles at the slightest touch.
炎.picture: A cartoon swollen red bump on an arm with two stacked flames rising from it.

曽.story: Scarecrow [horns] poke up over a [rice field] above the setting [sun]: this weedy lot was {formerly} a farm, and the scarecrow still guards it.
曽.picture: A horned scarecrow standing in an overgrown, abandoned rice field at sunset.

隺.story: A [crown] of red feathers sits on what looks like a long-legged [turkey]: really a {crane}, hammering with its beak.
隺.picture: A tall crane with a red feather crown pecking hard at a cactus on a stone.

忍.story: A [blade] presses right against your [heart], and you just grit your teeth and {endure} it without flinching, like a true ninja.
忍.picture: A calm ninja standing very still as a sword point rests against the heart drawn on his chest.

咸.story: A halberd from the [sign of the dog] swings over a wide-open [mouth]: soldiers roar a {battle cry} that shakes your chest as they charge.
咸.picture: Soldiers with halberds charging forward, mouths wide open in a roaring cry.

殳.story: A daredevil clamps a {missile} between his legs at the [crotch] and rides it up into a howling [wind], screaming all the way toward the neighbor's window.
殳.picture: A daredevil in goggles riding a small finned missile like a horse, the missile clamped between his legs, streaking up through howling swirls of wind toward a house window.

㐬.story: An upside-down [infant] tumbles head first, [human legs] kicking, past a lifeguard's [walking stick] poking up from the water: an {infant flood} of giggling babies.
㐬.picture: A stream of giggling babies floating head first down a river past a lifeguard's tall pole.

谷.story: Two pairs of slopes fan out from a peak and open onto a round basin below: a deep {valley} with a lake and cows at the bottom.
谷.picture: A deep green valley between sloping hills, a lake and grazing cows at the bottom.

戠.story: Thumping [sound] booms out of a [fiesta] tent on the right: a {sound fiesta} so loud the walls throb.
戠.picture: A party tent with sound waves blasting out, the nearby wall visibly shaking.

則.story: Pay your [shells] or meet the [saber]: that's the {rule}, carved above the toll gate, and the guard means every word.
則.picture: A toll gate guard holding a saber next to a bowl of seashells paid by travelers.

戸.story: A [one] lintel caps a [flag] hanging beneath it like a curtain: a simple {door} that swings open on its pole.
戸.picture: A simple wooden door hanging from a beam like a curtain on a pole, swinging open.

咼.story: A skull [hood] with a little crossbar inside sits on a wider [hood] of ribs, over a gaping [mouth] of hip bones: a rattling {skeleton}, ready to race.
咼.picture: A friendly cartoon skeleton in running shoes at a starting line, its skull, ribcage and hip bones clearly visible.

祭.story: Both hands busy with torches, a villager carries a slab of [flesh] wedged at his [crotch] and waddles it onto the [altar] as everyone chants: the yearly {ritual}, lit by a roaring bonfire.
祭.picture: A villager holding a torch in each hand, waddling with a slab of meat wedged between his legs toward a stone altar, a chanting crowd around a roaring bonfire at a village festival.

系.story: A [slash] at the top starts a single [thread] that runs down through the generations: the family {lineage}, tied knot by knot on a scroll.
系.picture: A long scroll with a single thread running down it, knotted at intervals to mark each generation of a family tree.

且.story: A tall frame with two crossboards inside and a wide base: an empty {shelf}, waiting to be wrapped in thread.
且.picture: A tall empty wooden shelf with two boards, strands of yarn starting to wrap around it.

角.story: A curved tip on top, a hollow body ringed with ridges: a bull's {horn}, so long and hooked that kites and ropes keep snagging on it.
角.picture: A long curved ridged bull horn with a kite string snagged on its hooked tip.

侖.story: Under a [meeting roof], professors hang a [hood] over a stack of [twenty] scrolls: their prized {theory}, guarded from rivals.
侖.picture: Professors under a peaked roof covering a stack of scrolls with a cloth hood.

寅.story: Under the circus [house] roof, [one] ringmaster asks '[wherefore]?' as a tiger bounds through [eight] flaming hoops: the {sign of the tiger} blazes overhead.
寅.picture: A circus tent interior where a tiger leaps through a series of flaming hoops while a ringmaster watches.

敬.story: Tiny [young grass] sprouts stand up straight as the [taskmaster] walks by with his whip, trembling in {awe} of him.
敬.picture: Tiny grass sprouts standing stiffly at attention as a stern figure with a whip strides past.

兑.story: Two [horns] sprout from your [elder brother]'s head: meet your {horned brother}, who explains them to anyone who'll listen.
兑.picture: A young man with two small horns on his head pointing at them and talking eagerly.

憂.story: A tall stack of a heavy drooping head, a hidden [heart] and dragging feet: a figure bowed under {melancholy}, shuffling slowly.
憂.picture: A sad figure with a drooping head, shoulders slumped, shuffling slowly in the rain.

酉.story: A square bottle with a lid, a narrow neck, and a line of liquid sloshing inside: a {whiskey bottle}, half drunk.
酉.picture: A square glass whiskey bottle with a cork, half full of amber liquid.

韋.story: Two clasping halves above and below a round middle with a little chain loop: a heart-shaped {locket}, snapped shut over a photo.
韋.picture: A closed golden heart-shaped locket on a chain lying on a road.

冓.story: Beams crossed like a [well] frame sit on [one] long crossbar over a [hood]-shaped frame crossed by more beams: a sturdy wooden {lattice}, rigid enough to strap a back straight.
冓.picture: A sturdy wooden lattice frame of crossed beams, stacked in layers, leaning against a barn wall.

釆.story: A [slash] of red ink tops a scatter of [rice] grains arranged into a heart: a homemade {valentine} handed to a sweetheart.
釆.picture: A card with a heart made of rice grains and a red ink stroke above, held out by a smiling person.

吅.story: A [mouth] on the left and a [mouth] on the right squawk at once from one bird: {two mouths}, never quiet.
吅.picture: A bird with two beaks side by side, both squawking at once.

袁.story: A small head on top, a round collar, then yards of cloth trailing below: a giant's {long robe}, sweeping the ground wherever he goes.
袁.picture: A giant wearing a very long robe that trails far behind him across a grassy field.

皮.story: A hook and a hand stretch a hide taut across a frame: a hunter's {pelt}, pulled as tight as the skin of a drum.
皮.picture: An animal hide stretched tightly over a wooden frame like a drum skin.

坐.story: A [person] and a [person] plop down side by side on the bare [soil]: they {sit on the ground}, finally resting.
坐.picture: Two friendly travelers sit cross-legged on the bare earth facing each other, sharing tea on a little patch of soil under a tree.

畐.story: A lid on top, a [mouth]-shaped jar, and below it a [rice field] full to the brim: a stocked granary, all the {wealth} a family could pray for.
畐.picture: A lidded jar sitting on top of a square rice field overflowing with golden grain and coins.

罙.story: A [crown] lid covers a pit where [human legs] dangle above a [tree] growing far at the bottom: a {deep hole} with no end in sight.
罙.picture: Legs dangling over the edge of a very deep pit with a tiny tree far below at the bottom.

令.story: Under a [meeting roof], the mayor slams his official [stamp] down on a decree and barks out his {orders}.
令.picture: A mayor under a peaked meeting-hall roof slamming a big official rubber stamp onto a decree, shouting orders.

辛.story: A [vase] of chili oil balanced on a [ten]-pointed cross of peppers: so {spicy} that just looking at it makes your tongue burn.
辛.picture: A vase full of red chili oil balanced on a cross of red hot peppers, steam rising.

黄.story: A [salad] spills over a box stamped '[wherefore]?' that rolls on [eight] little legs: a bright {yellow} taxi delivering lunch.
黄.picture: A bright yellow taxi carrying a huge salad bowl on its roof.

甫.story: [ten] scratches on a [moon]-shaped tin disc and a [drop] of red paint: the runaway mutt's jingling {dog tag}.
甫.picture: A crescent-shaped metal dog tag with scratches and a dot of red paint, hanging from a running dog's collar.

奇.story: A [St. Bernard dog] balances on top of a [can], wobbling there and staring at you without blinking: something very {strange} is going on.
奇.picture: A St. Bernard dog balancing on top of a tin can, staring with wide unblinking eyes.

啇.story: Under a [top hat] with [horns], a [hood] covers something [old]: a dusty {antique} on display, priceless and fragile.
啇.picture: A dusty old object under a cloth cover on a shop shelf, topped with a horned hat.

杂.story: [nine] scrawny saplings crowd on top of one big [tree]: a thicket of {nine trees}, perfect for hiding junk.
杂.picture: A dense cluster of nine trees with junk like socks and spoons peeking out between them.

廷.story: Red carpet is [stretch]ed out long to a [porter] hauling the judge's bench into place: the {courts} are now in session.
廷.picture: A long red carpet leading to a porter carrying a heavy judge's bench in a grand hall.

孚.story: A mother [vulture] spreads her claws over a [child] in the nest below, sheltering her {brood} of fluffy chicks.
孚.picture: A large bird spreading its wings over a nest full of fluffy chicks.

奴.story: A [woman] on the left drags a lazy fellow by the [crotch] of his overalls: 'Get to work, {guy}!'
奴.picture: A woman tugging a lazy man in overalls toward a big boulder, pointing at it.

壴.story: [ten] drumsticks rattle down onto a pot of [beans] stretched with hide: a {drum} that booms and makes the beans jump inside.
壴.picture: A pot covered with stretched hide used as a drum, with many drumsticks striking it and beans bouncing.

埶.story: A gardener pats down [soil], kneels on [human legs], heaps more [soil], then drops in a [round] seed: the {planting} is done.
埶.picture: A gardener kneeling in a garden bed, heaping soil and dropping a round seed into it.

亥.story: A little cap on top and a fat, lopsided body with crooked cracks running down it: a giant {acorn}, ready to be carved.
亥.picture: A giant acorn with a cap and cracked shell, standing on the ground.

彦.story: A [vase on a cliff] teeters as a breeze blows [three hairs] loose on the head of a dashing {lad} posing beside it.
彦.picture: A dashing young man posing next to a vase on a cliff edge, his hair blowing in the wind.

舛.story: Two curved lenses face each other with a little bridge between them: a pair of {sunglasses} on a wriggling dancer.
舛.picture: A cheerful worm wearing sunglasses dancing alone on an empty stage.

昏.story: The [family name] carved on a gate stands above the [sun] sinking beneath it: {dusk}, when the wedding begins.
昏.picture: A wooden gate silhouetted against a sun sinking low in an orange evening sky.

舟.story: A narrow hull with two passengers sitting inside and a mast sticking up from the middle: a little rowing {boat}, bobbing in the water.
舟.picture: A small narrow wooden rowing boat with two passengers and a short mast, bobbing on water.

㕣.story: Water from [eight] streams pours down into a narrow [mouth] below: a steep {gully} where passing boats get wedged.
㕣.picture: Streams pouring down rocky slopes into a narrow gully with a small boat wedged inside.

莫.story: [flowers] laid on top, the [sun] setting in the middle, a [St. Bernard dog] keeping watch below: the quiet {graveyard} at closing time.
莫.picture: A graveyard at sunset with flowers on the headstones and a St. Bernard dog sitting watch.

兆.story: Cracks split out to both sides of a center line, each with a dot of soot: a tortoise shell cracked by fire, reading a dark {omen}.
兆.picture: A tortoise shell cracked into two sides by fire, with a dark cloud forming in the sky above.

复.story: A [banner top] flaps over the [sun] as [walking legs] march beneath it, around and around: the parade plays on {repeat}.
复.picture: A small parade marching in a circle under a flag and the sun, the same marchers passing again and again.

貫.story: A string of square-holed coins on top, a shell below, and one long rod driven straight through both: it can {pierce} anything.
貫.picture: A long metal rod pushed through a stack of square-holed coins and a seashell.

卦.story: Sprigs of [ivy] are tapped with a [magic wand], and their leaves rearrange into a reading: {divination} that tells your fortune.
卦.picture: A fortune teller tapping a pile of ivy sprigs with a magic wand, the leaves glowing and shifting.

斿.story: A signpost points the [direction], a [banner top] flutters beside it, and a [child] below runs holding a long {streamer}, rainbow ribbons trailing.
斿.picture: A child running past a signpost holding a long rainbow streamer, a flag fluttering nearby.

卸.story: A [banner top] over [one] counter, and a [stamp] slammed on the right onto every sack: rice sold {wholesale}, by the truckload.
卸.picture: A warehouse counter with a small flag, a worker stamping huge rice sacks piled high.

垔.story: Out in the Wild [west], a chimney rises from the [soil]: a tall black {smokestack}, puffing clouds over the frontier town.
垔.picture: A tall black smokestack rising from dusty ground in a Wild West town, puffing smoke clouds.

呉.story: A huge [mouth] gapes on top of a giant whose body reaches the [heavens]: a {shouting giant} booming so loudly the clouds shake.
呉.picture: A gentle giant towering into the clouds, mouth wide open as he shouts, the clouds trembling around his head.

苗.story: Tiny [flowers] sprout on top of a muddy [rice field]: each green {seedling} standing in neat rows.
苗.picture: Neat rows of tiny green seedlings with little flowers growing in a muddy rice paddy.

革.story: Horns at the top, a hide stretched wide across a frame, a tail hanging down the middle: raw {leather}, drying in the sun before it becomes shoes.
革.picture: A cowhide stretched on a wooden frame to dry in the sun, with horns at the top and a tail hanging down.

髟.story: On the left, [long] hair streams down to the floor; on the right, [three hairs] swoop outward: a wild mop of {shaggy hair} begging for a barber.
髟.picture: A cheerful person with extremely long hair streaming to the floor and three big swooping strands sticking out to the side, sitting in a barber's chair.

禺.story: A big round face with grid-like eyes over a long tail curling underneath: a cheeky {monkey} dangling in everyone's way.
禺.picture: A cheeky monkey with a big round face hanging by its curled tail from a branch.
